question_text: Outline the role of OS memory management when starting an application.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: The OS allocates memory for the process and tracks its use so the application can run without overwriting other processes’ memory.
